name: Resend MCP
summary: Resend's official MCP server for email: send and schedule emails, manage templates, broadcasts, contacts, domains, logs and webhooks. Hosted with OAuth or run locally.
description: The hosted server at https://mcp.resend.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, launched 2026-07-07) uses OAuth sign-in with permissions you can revoke in Team settings, or a Resend API key as a Bearer token for CI and headless agents. The same open-source code runs locally with `npx -y resend-mcp` and RESEND_API_KEY (stdio by default, HTTP optional); npm `resend-mcp` 2.28.0, MIT (136 tools, 56 with readOnlyHint:true; there is no read-only mode). Tool groups now include Inboxes (create/list/update inboxes, threads, labels, drafts, reply/forward). On stdio, unset `--allowed-file-dirs` leaves local file attachments and CSV imports unrestricted—set it so a prompt-injected agent cannot read outside chosen folders (HTTP disables file reads unless the flag is set). Resend API keys are only `full_access` or `sending_access`; there is no read-only key. Logged actions carry a user-agent trace. The Resend plugin (Agent Plugins format) bundles the remote server with Resend's agent skills. Resend's Free plan allows 100 emails a day.
